entities.summary: Branden B. Albert is an American former professional football player who was an offensive tackle for nine seasons in the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Virginia Cavaliers and was selected by the Kansas City Chiefs 15th overall in the 2008 NFL draft. He also played for the Miami Dolphins and was a member of Jacksonville Jaguars before announcing his retirement in 2017.
